This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.588/2023 registered at Police Station-City Kotwali Satna,
District-Satna (MP) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 471 of the IPC and Section 3, 4 of the Examination Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 18.08.2023.
Applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that applicant is a student and as per prosecution story, he had undertaken an examination on behalf of spurious candidate and other candidates.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
No offence under Section 467 of the IPC is made out against applicant, since, there was no forgery of any valuable document.
Other offences are punishable up to seven years of imprisonment.
In these circumstances, he prayed that applicant may be released on bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5 .
Applicant is in jail since 18.08.2023.
Applicant has not forged any valuable security or Will.
Offence under Section 471 is bailable and offence under Section 420 is punishable up to seven years of imprisonment.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application stands allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond o f Rs.50,000/- (Rs.
